incidence: Each category on fixed eligible denominator; unresolved is not labelled Incorrect. Missing has its own incidence. Correct/(Correct+Incorrect) separately labelled assessed-only sensitivity.
task_success: All requested components correctly delivered in an answer, no material false claim; partial correct claims are not success; unresolved boundary yields Uncertain, no automatic failure.
unknown_bounds: Original signed weights with unknown success in [0,1]; no cell renormalization. Complete-case contrast is a selection-sensitive alternative estimand.
aggregation: Equal case contributions within speaker, equal speaker weights; report case-weighted sensitivity if attrition changes balance. N/A contrasts explicitly inapplicable.

uncertainty.bootstrap: 10000 whole-speaker draws containing both cases and all cells, seed 716201; percentile sensitivity
uncertainty.primary_interval: 95% cluster-SE interval and conservative Bonferroni six-comparison interval; normal approximation must be checked by simulation and distribution diagnostics
uncertainty.ordinal: Full distributions and paired sign/rank sensitivity; ties retained, descriptive means not interval-scale proof

multiplicity: Six primary comparisons form one family; report Bonferroni intervals. Other 16-by-endpoint summaries are exploratory, no selected significance claims.
no_adaptive_stopping: Complete fixed cohort; stop only integrity/safety failure. Do not select by C0/no-history correctness or interim effects.
model_sensitivity: 24 prospectively selected speaker clusters, both cases and all cells; model paired differences of case contrasts, 24 clusters, secondary. No independent-arm assumption.
